title: Voltage results table
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 36 (Voltage results table (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 36: Voltage: the push of a cell. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To measure the voltage across components
equipment: A circuit kit or the portal simulation
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Build a circuit with one cell and one lamp
Connect the voltmeter in parallel across the lamp
Add a second lamp in series and measure across each
Repeat with the lamps in parallel

questions.q: Big question: what does 9 V tell you compared with 1.5 V?
questions.a: A bigger push: more energy given to the charge.
